lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like distribution of approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills, extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance bands intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct grid pattern where blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal line on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side, extending from the post-gill region posteriorly.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, diffuse high-luminance spots contained within the boundary of the dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish attached to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin and the lower lateral flank.
